issues: Mobile (11): the amount/meta line still wobbles. Fernleitung puts '1.505.036 €' and 'Near cap · 75% of 2.000.000 €' on two lines, while Ringschluss and Maschinentechnik put amount and meta on one. In Kit.tsx Row, change the amount wrapper 'flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-x-3 … sm:block' to 'flex flex-col gap-0.5 sm:block' so every row stacks amount, then meta.
Row hover is hover:bg-slate-50 on a white page (about 1.04:1), so pointer users get almost no hover feedback on project rows. In Kit.tsx Row, use hover:bg-slate-100.

Hero secondary pill 'Upload files' (Button variant secondary, bg-slate-100) now sits on white, and its fill is the only edge (about 1.1:1). Add ring-1 ring-inset ring-slate-200 to the secondary variant so the pill shape reads, the same way the selected Chip does.
Mobile (11): the top-bar search trigger truncates to 'Search projects, lists, posit…'. Below sm, show the shorter label 'Search' (keep the full aria-label).

Money precision is mixed on one screen. The hero shows '1.505.036 €' and the meta uses whole euros, but list rows show cents ('988.913,89 €', '516.122,50 €'), and Active Budgets shows the same list as '988.914 €'. In ListCard, use moneyWhole for the row amount, and keep cents for the ledger and drawer only.

The editable cap button '2.000.000 € cap' has accessible name '2.000.000 € cap'. The only hint that it changes the cap is title='Change cap', which screen readers and touch users often miss. Add a 16px 'edit' icon (text-slate-600, aria-hidden) after the text, and an sr-only ', change' suffix so the name starts with the visible text (2.5.3).

Document rows repeat the type: the title is 'Angebot AN24-0305.pdf' and the subtitle is 'PDF'. Show the page count, or 'Original upload', as the subtitle instead, so screen readers don't hear the type twice.
List row hover is bg-slate-50 on white (about 1.04:1), so the hover seen on 'Angebot AN24-0305' is barely perceptible. Use hover:bg-slate-100 (same Row fix as S1).

The 'Search positions' field (ListPage) is border-transparent bg-slate-100 on white. Its boundary is about 1.1:1, so it fails WCAG 1.4.11, and the Categories search input has the same problem. Give both a resting 'border-slate-400' (or ring-1 ring-inset ring-slate-400), and keep focus:border-brand-600.

Group header rows still use <th scope='colgroup' colSpan={6}> (LedgerTable). For a row that labels the positions below it, wrap each category in its own <tbody> and use <th scope='rowgroup'>, so screen readers announce the category for each position cell.
The Kurztext cell button opens the detail drawer, but only title='Show full description' says so. Add aria-haspopup='dialog' and an sr-only ', open details' suffix to the button.

Categories popover (CategoryFilter) closes on Escape and outside pointerdown, but tabbing past 'All'/'None'/the tree leaves it open behind the focus. Close it on focusout when relatedTarget is outside root.current.

ExportDialog (opened by Export on this screen) uses text-slate-400 for 11px text: the file name, the format icons, the category OZ, and '(not part of tender formats)'/'(always in this format)'. That is about 2.6:1 on white. Use text-slate-600, and make that text at least 12px.

The edited marker is a 6px brand dot (EditDot), aria-hidden, with a title. On desktop that is a tiny colour-only cue. Make it size-2 and add a visible 'Edited' text hint on row hover, or tint the edited value text-brand-700 font-semibold, so it isn't dot-colour alone.

The Menge, Einheit and Einheitspreis inputs sit inside <Labeled> (a <label>) and also have aria-label. aria-label overrides the visible text, so the name is 'Einheitspreis' while the screen shows 'Einheitspreis (EP)'. Remove the three aria-label props and let the <label> text name them.

Previous/next (chevron up/down) swap the whole content, but focus stays on the chevron and nothing is announced. Put aria-live='polite' on the '1 of 197' counter span, or move focus to the Kurztext title (tabIndex=-1 wrapper) after navigating.

The Kurztext title textarea has no resting edit cue: border-transparent, and hover:border-slate-300 is about 1.5:1. Show a 16px slate-500 'edit' icon at the right of the title on hover and focus-within, and use hover:border-slate-400.

Footer: 'Changes save automatically' (left) and the live 'Saved' (right, emerald-700) sit at opposite ends. Render 'Saved' in place of the helper text for 2 seconds after a commit, so sighted users see it where they read.
Drawer fields use inputCls with border-slate-300 (about 1.5:1 on white, fails 1.4.11). Use border-slate-400 (see global).

The hero meta button underlines the whole phrase '1 list near its cap · none over', but only the first part is an action. Make only '1 list near its cap' the button, and render ' · none over' as plain text after it.

Choosing 'Needs attention' (chip or hero link) filters the list, but focus stays where it was and the result isn't announced. After setView('attention'), move focus to the 'Lists' h2 (tabIndex=-1) and announce '1 list needs attention' in a polite sr-only live region.

Folder-tinted avatar tiles (fuchsia, blue, cyan) look like a status code next to the green and orange meters, but the subtitle already names the project. Use tone='slate' for list rows on this page, so colour here only means budget status.

The empty-state text in Collections.tsx still has the literal '⋯' glyph ('from its ⋯ menu'), which screen readers announce as 'midline horizontal ellipsis'. Write 'from its More options (⋯) menu' with the glyph in <span aria-hidden>, or drop the glyph.

The subtitle 'Archived projects don't count toward totals' and the body 'It stops counting toward your totals' say the same thing. Cut the body to 'Archive a project from its More options menu to set it aside.'
The centred empty state floats about a third of the way down, under a left-aligned header, which leaves a large dead area. Left-align it under the H1 (max-w-md, icon inline with the title).
Wise: same as S6. The centred empty state under a left-aligned header leaves a large dead area. Left-align it to the content column under the H1.

Group headings ('Projects 1', 'Lists 4', 'Positions 8') are role='presentation' divs inside role='listbox', so screen-reader users lose the grouping. Wrap each group's options in <div role='group' aria-labelledby={headingId}>, and give the heading that id with no presentation role.
Tab always refocuses the input (onKey preventDefault), so keyboard users can never reach the 'Esc' close button. Let Tab and Shift+Tab cycle between the input and the close button.

List result subtitles fall back to raw file names ('LV_10_Stahlbetonfertigteile_Stuetzen_Binder.pdf'), which repeat the title and are long and noisy for screen readers. When phaseLabel is empty, use '<n> positions' instead of l.fileName.
The active option is shown only by bg-brand-50 plus ring-brand-200 (about 1.3:1 against white). Use ring-brand-600 (or a 3px left brand-600 bar) so the active row meets 3:1 for keyboard users.

'Set a budget cap' is a lone brand text button below the format hint, cut off from the two actions. Move it into the header kebab, or make it a third ghost pill in the action row, so all next steps sit together.

Wise: the dashed drop zone is border-transparent until a drag starts, so the 'drop anywhere' promise has no resting visual. Show a faint resting border-slate-200 dashed outline around the empty state, or drop the dashed treatment and rely on the full-page DropOverlay.

global_issues: inputCls still uses border-slate-300 (about 1.5:1 on white, fails WCAG 1.4.11) for every dialog and drawer text field. Change it to border-slate-400. The filled pill fields ('Search positions', 'Search categories…') rely on bg-slate-100 (about 1.1:1) and need a resting ring-slate-400 too.

The pointer:coarse 44px rule now covers labels and size-8, but not h-8. Button size='sm' (h-8, e.g. FolderPage 'Restore'), ErrorBoundary 'Try again'/'Go home' (h-8) and the DocViewer 'Open'/'Download' links (h-8) stay 32px on touch. Add .h-8 to the selector in index.css.

Dialog (ui.tsx) traps Tab but doesn't call useInertRoot, unlike DetailDrawer, CommandPalette and the mobile Sidebar. Screen-reader virtual cursors can leave Add position, Export, Cap and Rename into the page. Call useInertRoot(open) in Dialog.
ExportDialog uses text-slate-400 for 11px text (file name, OZ codes, format notes), about 2.6:1. Use text-slate-600 and at least 12px.
Row hover across Kit Row and LedgerTable is bg-slate-50 on white (about 1.04:1). Use hover:bg-slate-100 so pointer users get visible hover feedback.

Still no tailwind-merge. IconButton's base 'size-9' plus className 'size-10' (DetailDrawer) only works because of CSS source order. Add cn() = twMerge(clsx(...)) in Button, IconButton, ToolButton and Meter.

Selected or active states (Chips, CommandPalette option, Categories trigger when filtered) use bg-brand-50 + ring-brand-200 (about 1.3:1 boundary). Selected chips also have aria-pressed and bolder text, so they pass, but the palette option relies on the ring alone. Use ring-brand-600 for active options.
